chunks: Axial Foundry — Knowledge Base Source: https://www.axialfoundary.com/ 1. Company Overview Axial Foundry is a premium AI, software, and web development studio based in Lahore, Pakistan. It is a founder-led team that builds production-grade digital systems for ambitious teams, with a strong emphasis on execution over idea decks. Core positioning lines used on the site: "AI, Software & Web Development Studio" "Premium software and AI studio" "Software, AI, and digital systems built for teams that need execution." "We build websites, custom software, automation, and applied AI systems for startups, SMEs, and enterprise teams. Founder-led delivery, research-backed engineering, shipped from one team." Key differentiators: Small, hand-picked team of about 8 people. No padded titles, no offshore layers. Combines applied AI (LLMs, RAG, Speech) with full-stack software engineering and design under one roof. Research credibility (peer-reviewed publications, international experience) paired with practical, production-focused delivery. End-to-end ownership: strategy, architecture, UX, implementation, QA, launch, and iteration. Business-friendly communication with clear scoping and trade-offs. Custom builds tailored to the right level of complexity, not generic templates. Location and contact: Lahore, Pakistan. Email: axialfoundary@gmail.com Phone: +92 323 5809900 2. Services and Solution Shapes The four main service categories Axial Foundry builds are: Premium Websites Web Apps and Portals Applied AI Systems Automation and Data Eight typical solution shapes (real client-grounded examples): 1. AI customer support assistant — Brand-aligned, answers questions, routes conversations, and hands off cleanly. Often integrated with WhatsApp. 2. Internal knowledge assistant — Turns scattered documents into a searchable RAG layer for internal teams. 3. CRM-connected chatbot workflow — Conversational layer linked to CRM, WhatsApp, and existing workflows. 4. Custom business dashboard — Reporting surface for pipelines, exceptions, and operational metrics. 5. Premium company website — Modern, conversion-aware, authoritative web presence. 6. Workflow automation system — Removes repetitive admin and connects internal tools. 7. Client portal or web app — Focused apps for customers, partners, or internal teams. 8. Speech and transcription workflow — Transcription, diarization, and voice-enabled processing. Broader capabilities: Applied AI: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, evaluation, instruction tuning, Speech AI (ASR, diarization, TTS), Urdu and low-resource language NLP, and computer vision. Software Engineering: Python (Django, Flask, NestJS), REST and GraphQL APIs, SQL and PostgreSQL, and broader backend systems. Web and Product Delivery: Business websites, web apps, portals, dashboards, UX planning, launch support, and design-to-code in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Automation and Data: Web scraping, data pipelines, CRM integration, reporting, monitoring, workflow systems, and GIS and spatial systems (Mapbox, ArcGIS, Google Earth Engine). Axial Foundry explicitly builds both AI-heavy and non-AI solutions. They build premium websites, web apps, and automation projects, and add AI selectively where it creates clear value. They support agencies as a technical delivery partner and can work inside existing stacks and products. 3. Team and Credentials Team size: about 8 people, with roughly 5 in AI and Engineering and 3 in Design and Frontend. Notable team members: Munief Hassan Tahir — Co-founder and ML Engineer (NLP and Speech AI). Trained Urdu LLMs on 800M+ tokens with state-of-the-art benchmarks. Ships RAG-powered

and products. 3. Team and Credentials Team size: about 8 people, with roughly 5 in AI and Engineering and 3 in Design and Frontend. Notable team members: Munief Hassan Tahir — Co-founder and ML Engineer (NLP and Speech AI). Trained Urdu LLMs on 800M+ tokens with state-of-the-art benchmarks. Ships RAG-powered assistants for government and enterprise. Builds ASR and TTS systems for low-resource languages. DAAD fellow in Germany. Trainer at the University of Moratuwa in Sri Lanka. Has worked with clients in New York City, London, and India. Hunain Azam — AI Engineer (NLP and Computer Vision). Co-author on an English–Urdu corpora paper. Built VocaTrust, a multilingual mental-health assistant using LLaMA-3.1, RAG, and clinical assessment. Hafiza Maham — Full-Stack Engineer (Web and AI). Builds AI agents using Qwen and RAG. Built Sketch2Design, a SaaS that converts wireframes to UI. LangChain and Prompt Engineering certified. Other team members cover backend (Django, NestJS), frontend, design, web GIS, architecture, and senior engineering input. Credentials and experience: 4+ years delivering production-grade systems. 3 peer-reviewed publications, including LREC 2026, EACL 2026, and ChipSAL 2025. A LoResMT 2026 paper is also part of the team's body of work. International exposure (Germany, Sri Lanka) combined with practical execution. Founder-led from strategy to launch. 4. Why Clients Choose Axial Foundry Six reasons clients choose Axial Foundry: 1. End-to-end delivery — one relationship for the whole project. 2. Software and AI under one roof — full system delivery, not just the model layer. 3. Founder-led execution — faster decisions and less translation loss. 4. Custom builds, not templates. 5. Business-friendly communication. 6. Research credibility without unnecessary complexity. Best-fit clients: Startups, SMEs, agencies, enterprise teams, service businesses, and knowledge-heavy organizations that need a practical, technically strong partner. Engagement start: Most engagements begin with a discovery and scoping conversation, then move into strategy, design, and implementation. The team replies within one business day. Scoping calls are founder-led. 5. Featured Work and Case Studies Case 1: Healthcare Distribution (India, 2024–2025) Multi-turn customer support assistant on WhatsApp. RAG over the client's product catalogue and FAQ. Flask backend, OpenAI-based logic, Twilio and WhatsApp integration, conversation storage, CRM handoff, and automated follow-ups. Outcome: Better customer engagement and removal of manual triage. Case 2: Hospitality Intelligence (UK, 2023–2024) Large-scale scraping of more than 1 million restaurants combined with monitoring dashboards. Resilient data pipelines, Django dashboards, and SQL normalization. Outcome: Reliable data with real-time visibility for the client team. Additional Themes RAG-powered knowledge assistants. Speech transcription and diarization workflows. LLM adaptation, evaluation, and instruction tuning. Custom portals, backend systems, and dashboards. 6. FAQ Highlights Yes, the team builds websites and software without advanced AI. They are a strong fit for premium sites, web apps, automations, and selective AI features. They can integrate with existing products and stacks. They support post-launch refinement and ongoing technical support as needed. Agencies are welcome as technical partners. 7. Contact and Process The project enquiry form on the contact page asks for: What help is needed (specific options include AI Chatbot or Assistant, RAG or Knowledge Assistant, LLM Fine-tuning, Speech AI, Website Development, Web Application Development, Automation and Backend Systems, Data Pipelines and Scraping, Product or MVP Build, Research Collaboration, and Other). Budget range and timeline. A short project description. Process: A founder reviews the brief, replies directly, and runs a scoping call if there is a fit. Communication is transparent, with no black-box behaviour. To get in touch you can: Use the chatbot's "Contact Us" option to submit your details directly. Visit the /contact page on the website. Email axialfoundary@gmail.com. Call +92 323 5809900. 8. Privacy and Data Handling Axial Foundry collects contact and project information (name, email, phone, company, project details, budget, and timeline) through forms and the chatbot. This information is used only for responding to enquiries, evaluating fit, and direct business communication. Information is not sold to third parties. Information is stored in a database for follow-up and may be retained for legitimate business or legal reasons. Users may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their information at any time. The site uses minimal cookies and analytics.
